quote: Whenever lights are displayed upon a vehicle lawfully parked at nighttime upon any highway, such lights shall be depressed or dimmed, in the event cowl or parking lamps are not used.

activation.description: Lights displayed on a lawfully parked vehicle at nighttime on a highway
activation.source_clause: Whenever lights are displayed upon a vehicle lawfully parked at nighttime upon any highway

obligation.description: Displayed lights depressed or dimmed when no cowl or parking lamps are used
obligation.source_clause: such lights shall be depressed or dimmed

exceptions.description: Cowl or parking lamps are used
exceptions.source_clause: in the event cowl or parking lamps are not used

timing.description: Review the entire parked nighttime displayed-light interval
timing.source_clause: Whenever lights are displayed upon a vehicle lawfully parked at nighttime upon any highway

judgment_calls_needed.phrase: lawfully parked at nighttime upon any highway
judgment_calls_needed.note: Join original highway geometry, parking-rule composition, civil clock and sunset/sunrise sources; sun altitude alone is insufficient.

judgment_calls_needed.phrase: such lights shall be depressed or dimmed
judgment_calls_needed.note: Independent four-camera optical review must establish emitted lamp state throughout the interval, separate from CARLA request bits.

judgment_calls_needed.phrase: in the event cowl or parking lamps are not used
judgment_calls_needed.note: Review actual cowl or parking lamp use; parking lamp use exercises the disjunctive exception, not a headlamp-intensity cutoff.
